positioning: Lightweight custom computer vision architecture and direct next-generation competitor to the YOLO family
modules: 2D anchor-free multi-scale detection (P3, P4, P5 strides 8, 16, 32)
Multi-class Cross Entropy + Multiclass Dice with ignore-index
Morphological boundary loss on raw logits (Focal + Dice)
Discriminative instance embedding loss (L_var + L_dist + L_reg)
Camera-aware DEM (inverse depth rho <-> metric depth Z)
Dense 3D pointcloud unprojection via camera intrinsics K
Oriented 3D IoU with rotated BEV polygon intersection
Object-specific 3D supervision on assigned positive detections
Multi-view geometric augmentation with inverse transform tracking
Adaptive uncertainty loss weighting with modality masking
COCO multi-task dataset adapter with polygon rasterization
Comprehensive evaluation metric suite: mAP50, mAP50:95, mIoU, Boundary F1, Depth RMSE/AbsRel
training_note: COCO dataset adapter fully rasterizes semantic/instance/boundary targets and masks missing depth/3D modalities (m_t in {0, 1}) with zero leakage.
status: fully verified end-to-end; unit tests passing; overfit test converged; real benchmarks measured on RTX 5060 Laptop GPU
publication_guidance: Benchmarks report verified FLOPs, parameter counts, memory, and CPU/GPU latency. Formal validation mAP/mIoU scores require a full 300-epoch training schedule on COCO/NYUv2. Comparative YOLO baseline is attributed as a state-of-the-art anchor-free 2D detection baseline.
